name: Konstantinos Arvanitis - § 112/2
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: ‘calls on the Commission and the Member States to ensure that migration and asylum policies, including the Pact on Migration and Asylum, are implemented in full compliance with the Charter, the principle of non-refoulement and the principle of responsibility-sharing to ensure that people’s rights to asylum and international protection are upheld;’
